invariants.rationale: The instantTime string should not be null as it likely identifies the commit time or operation instance.
The partition path must be a valid, non-empty string to identify the data partition.
A valid fileId is required to identify the target file for merging updates.
The map of records to update should not be null or empty; otherwise, no update work would be needed.
There must be a data file to be merged as this handle operates on an existing file.
